title: Quality Engineer, Product QA (In-house Curitiba)
description:
Job Overview

Would you thrive in a role where technical rigor, product assurance and collaboration with cross‑functional manufacturing teams ensure flawless execution of in‑house production?

Would you bring the critical thinking, discipline and problem‑solving mindset needed to drive continuous improvement in fabrication, assembly and product validation processes?

Join our Quality Team!

At Baker Hughes, Quality is essential to delivering safe, reliable and high‑performing products. Our Product QA team ensures alignment with the Quality Management System (QMS), customer requirements and industry standards across internal manufacturing operations.

Partner with the best!

As a Quality Engineer, Product QA (In‑house Curitiba), you will ensure technical requirements are properly implemented and verified throughout fabrication, assembly and validation activities inside our Curitiba plant. You will support audits, risk assessments, first‑article inspections, non‑conformance management and continuous improvement initiatives to guarantee flawless execution.

Responsibilities

  • Reviewing and improving in‑house product quality performance on a frequent basis.
  • Collaborating with Lean initiatives to enable process improvements and flawless execution.
  • Leading first‑article inspection (FAI) processes internally, ensuring product and process alignment with requirements using risk assessment tools such as FMEA.
  • Conducting product quality audits and performing routine Gemba walks to validate compliance to technical specifications.
  • Acting as a risk assessor for manufacturing processes and mitigating identified execution risks.
  • Supporting and/or leading Go/No‑Go reviews and facilitating pre‑production meetings.
  • Capturing, resolving and communicating operational Lessons Learned to Supply Chain and Product Delivery teams.
  • Promoting quality culture by conducting continuous improvement workshops.
  • Identifying, reviewing and addressing product non‑conformances and driving strategic corrective actions.
  • Implementing and monitoring product Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Communicating approaches and methods for solving complex quality issues.
  • Ensuring adherence to Product Line quality directives at fabrication sites.
  • Witnessing in‑house product inspections and qualification activities.
  • Registering and escalating critical observations to the appropriate levels of the organization.
  • Leading manufacturing review processes for new first articles with relevant stakeholders.
  • Acting as an enabler for implementing Non‑Conformance Management processes within internal operations.

Qualifications

  • Have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Production Engineering.
  • Have fluent English skills.
  • Have knowledge of Brazilian customer quality requirements for subsea equipment fabrication (XT, Manifolds, Tooling).
  • Have previous experience in Quality Control for subsea equipment fabrication.
  • Have experience performing quality and product requirement audits.
  • Have knowledge in product inspection processes and technical documentation analysis.
  • Have experience using quality tools such as A3, 8D, 5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA, 5S and Lean Six‑Sigma.
  • Have strong leadership skills.
  • Have negotiation and influencing abilities with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Have the ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications and quality requirements.
  • Have a Master’s degree in a Quality‑related discipline. (Desirable)
  • Have technical qualification or certification in Dimensional, Painting, Welding, NDT or Fabrication inspection. (Desirable)

Flexible Working

  • Working flexible hours – from 7am‑4pm or from 8am‑5pm.
  • Location: Curitiba, PR.

About Us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well‑being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Benefits

  • Contemporary work‑life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Quality Senior Specialist – QA Engineering

About Company

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

description:
Job Description: Accounts Receivable Analyst

Position: Accounts Receivable Analyst Department: Finance Location: Lapa, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Reports to: Accounts Receivable Manager / Finance Manager

Job Summary

The Accounts Receivable Analyst is responsible for managing and processing incoming payments, ensuring accurate record-keeping, reconciling customer accounts, and supporting the company's cash flow management. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with internal teams and external customers.

Key Responsibilities

Billing & Payment Processing

  • Generate and issue customer invoices accurately and on time.
  • Record and reconcile incoming payments, ensuring correct allocation to customer accounts.
  • Monitor outstanding balances and follow up on overdue payments.
  • Process credit notes, adjustments, and refunds as necessary.

Reconciliation & Reporting

  • Reconcile customer accounts, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
  • Prepare and analyze aging reports to track overdue accounts.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities with necessary reports and reconciliations.

Collections & Customer Communication

  • Contact customers regarding overdue payments and negotiate payment arrangements when necessary.
  • Maintain strong customer relationships by addressing payment-related inquiries and disputes.
  • Work closely with the sales and customer service teams to resolve billing discrepancies.

Compliance & Process Improvement

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and financial regulations.
  • Assist in audits by providing necessary documentation and responding to inquiries.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation to enhance efficiency.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in accounts receivable, finance, or accounting.
  • Strong knowledge of accounts receivable processes, invoicing, and financial regulations.
  • Proficiency in ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) and Microsoft Excel.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Effective communication and negotiation skills for customer interactions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the hospitality a plus.
  • Knowledge of credit risk assessment and collections strategies.
  • Familiarity with automated accounts receivable systems.

Work Environment & Benefits

  • on-site work depending on company policy.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Career development and learning opportunities.

A Origem Energia

Nosso propósito é contribuir para o desenvolvimento do Brasil por meio da integração energética de maneira segura, inovadora e eficiente.

Descrição da vaga

Nosso propósito é contribuir para o desenvolvimento do Brasil por meio da integração energética de maneira segura, inovadora e eficiente. Aqui, energia não nos falta para buscar os melhores resultados, sempre com a segurança em primeiro lugar. Na Origem não existem problemas “dos outros”, trabalhamos unidos como um só time e somos eficientes em tudo que fazemos, evitando desperdícios. Entendemos que só assim continuaremos crescendo, gerando oportunidades para todos e contribuindo para uma transição segura da matriz energética brasileira rumo a uma economia de baixo carbono.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar na gestão do planejamento tático operacional de atividades de manutenção e outras realizadas no ativo, assegurando a execução eficiente das atividades, o monitoramento de cronogramas e recursos, a análise de indicadores de desempenho e a proposição de melhorias nos processos de planejamento.

  • Gestão do planejamento tático operacional da operação, assegurando a execução eficiente das atividades de médio e curto prazo.
  • Monitorar a execução dos planos de manutenção (semanal, mensal, trimestral), avaliando o cumprimento de cronogramas, priorizações e recursos.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na eficiência dos processos de planejamento, contribuindo com a padronização e automação de rotinas.
  • Análise crítica de indicadores de desempenho, visando identificar desvios, oportunidades e necessidades de correção.
  • Monitoramento de cronogramas, entregas, projetos e planos de ação, com identificação de pontos críticos e suporte à tomada de decisão para o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.
  • Interface com todas as áreas da empresa, promovendo comunicação fluida e alinhamento contínuo com as diretrizes estratégicas.
  • Elaboração de apresentações gerenciais e executivas periódicas, com foco em andamento, resultados e projeções.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Conhecimento de metodologias de Manutenção, tais como Manutenção Produtiva Total (TPM), Manutenção Centrada na Confiabilidade (RCM) ou World Class Maintenance (WCM).
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de Gestão da Manutenção (CMMS) ou com módulos de Planejamento da Manutenção de sistemas ERP (ex: SAP PM, TOTVS).
  • Conhecimento do SAP MM.
  • Gestão de KPIs.
  • Gestão Orçamentária.
  • Habilidade para analisar dados.
  • Conhecimento de Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimento de Power BI.
  • Forte raciocínio analítico e pensamento crítico.
  • Capacidade de gestão, liderança e influência sobre equipes.
  • Proatividade, organização e foco em resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação e bom relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Visão estratégica e capacidade de apresentar dados formatados para facilitar a tomada de decisões.

Informações adicionais

Regime: Administrativo e horário: 09h às 18h

Benefícios oferecidos

  • Assistência odontológica para o titular e seus dependentes.

  • Wellhub.
  • Programa de remuneração variável (PLR).

VEM SER ORIGEM!

Estamos entre as principais companhias independentes com atuação no Onshore do Brasil. Nosso maior diferencial é produzir energia por meio do gás natural, recurso energético mais estável e limpo. Com isso, participamos ativamente da expansão e da transformação da matriz de energia brasileira rumo à economia de baixo carbono.

Somos movidos pelo propósito de contribuir para o desenvolvimento do país mediante a integração energética de maneira segura, inovadora e eficiente. Priorizamos a execução de estratégias e projetos responsáveis para promover um desenvolvimento mais homogêneo das regiões onde atuamos .

Nossa origem é feminina , com diferentes nacionalidades e culturas. Temos o compromisso com a diversidade e a pluralidade. Nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória cheia de energia com audácia, empreendedorismo, inovação e busca por oportunidades. Juntos, vamos apoiar na transição segura da matriz energética brasileira.

O time Origem conta com a sua energia.

title: Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.

Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Role: Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager at Canonical

Ubuntu is the fastest growing enterprise Linux, the leading platform for public cloud computing, and the engineer's favorite way to drive the future.

Our goal is to help the enterprise embrace open source from end to end, across every class of compute and every class of application, starting with the linux kernel itself, to infrastructure solutions like OpenStack and Kubernetes, all the way up to data, security, analytics and serverless capabilities.

The Silicon Alliances Team works with the leading semiconductor companies to combine open source adoption with innovative optimizations to get the most from each new chip. With our semiconductor partners, we develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, formulate go‑to‑market plans and conceptualize new business models, enabling differentiated hardware and robust product life‑cycle support while still anchored to best‑in‑class Ubuntu. The end goal is a frictionless experience to deploy, maintain, and develop on any hardware from cloud to edge.

The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development. We are hiring for positions across early career to senior roles, with scope ranging from small exploratory partnerships to managing our largest and most strategic partnerships.

If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you.

Location

We are hiring for remote roles in Americas. We will also consider applicants in EMEA who can accommodate a shifted schedule to support Silicon partners in Americas. Global travel to sprints, events, and partner meetings is part of the role.

What your day will look like

  • Represent Canonical, its solutions and software to partners.
  • Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical's current and future products.
  • Work cross‑functionally with engineering, product, marketing and sales teams to facilitate new business, leading definition of joint products, solutions and complex programs relying heavily on your communicating and influencing skills.
  • Ensure that robust project plans are created, tracked, and executed.
  • Develop joint Go To Market strategy and campaigns with silicon partners, manage market messaging, collateral and launch plans across products.
  • Negotiate successful contracts.

What we are looking for in you

  • B.A / B.S / B.E degree in science, technology and/or engineering.
  • Fundamental understanding of the semiconductor industry and ecosystem.
  • Experience in software and system architecture is preferred.
  • Customer‑facing experience in business development, technology strategy or similar functions.
  • Excellent communication skills; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.
  • Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels.
  • Disciplined and self‑motivated for a remote‑first workplace environment.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with open source software and open source business models is preferred.
  • Team leadership or program management experience.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: MIU MIU Store Manager
description:
Fondato nel 1913 in Italia, il Gruppo Prada si è costruito su una tradizione di eccellenza e con una visione di innovazione. Il Gruppo, leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, opera in oltre 45 paesi con i marchi PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church's, Car Shoe e Luna Rossa e conta dipendenti di oltre 100 nazionalità.

Job Purpose

To be the owner of the business, a Company Brand Ambassador and a business leader, accountable for overall store performance. To guarantee an extraordinary Client experience, being present on the sales floor, leading and supporting all activities to achieve store targets. To manage and coach the store team and to ensure succession plans and internal growth.

Responsibilities

BUSINESS

  • Drive and maximize sales performances.
  • Propose and develop business plans.
  • Drive the store team to exceed their KPIs.
  • Represent the Company on the local market, identifying new opportunities to increase customer footfall, attracts new Clients and builds a loyal relationship with the brand.
  • Be present on the sales floor, ensuring a proper approach and service to the Clients.
  • Foster the Omni Channel development through the team.
  • Meet the store-operating budget, controlling store expenses.

CUSTOMER

  • Foster a Client centric mindset by developing and maintaining solid Client relationships.
  • Guarantee an excellent Client satisfaction and the highest level of Client service.
  • Implement, in partnership with other company functions, clienteling initiatives and events, securing Client loyalty and increasing Client spending.
  • Foster a strong private appointment culture.

TEAM

  • Promote an entrepreneurial and team spirit using effective communication, ensuring efficient organization and professional growth.
  • Ensure the team is always prepared and updated on the Prada Group main information, product knowledge, local market, competitors, policies and procedures.
  • The ideal Store Manager is able to attract and recruit the best talents available on the market through networking and scouting.

RETAIL

  • Develop a proper sales strategy, in cooperation with the Retail Merchandising, Visual Merchandising and Retail Operations teams.
  • Ensures that the display attracts Clients and maximizes sales in accordance with Company guidelines.
  • Participate in the buying session when requested and in any case he/she provides effective product feedback based on store needs.
  • Ensure synergy and cooperation between front and back of house.
  • Is responsible for the enforcement of Company procedures on cash activity, inventory, logistics and all the main reporting activities requested by the head office.

EVENTS

  • Cooperate with the Retail Events Office for the organization of local events and defines a challenging and realistic target per Client, proposing new opportunities for local events in partnership with local Stakeholders and Influencers.

Knowledge And Skills

  • Business driven
  • Leadership and team management
  • Ability to motivate and persuade people
  • Strong customer service mindset
  • Natural ability to welcome our client
  • Confident, enthusiastic and positive
  • Mature and assertive
  • Organized and detail oriented
  • Market and product knowledge/passion
  • Business/Retail Management degree or equivalent is a plus
  • Interest in luxury/fashion, art and design
  • Fluent Portuguese and advanced English

Entrare a far parte della nostra Azienda significa lavorare in un ambiente creativo e internazionale, con team di persone motivate dalla curiosità e dalla ricerca dell'eccellenza. Il motore del nostro successo è l'importanza e il valore che diamo al talento e alla passione delle nostre persone, favorendone la crescita professionale.

Il Gruppo Prada promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, garantendo pari opportunità a tutti i candidati, indipendentemente da genere, etnia, orientamento sessuale, disabilità, o altre caratteristiche personali. Crediamo che la diversità sia un valore e ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente di lavoro equo e rispettoso per tutti.

The Role

  • Finance at Emergence is not “reporting after the fact.” It is how we make decisions. The bar is high because the work gets used in real rooms with real stakes.

What Makes Someone Successful Here

This is not a role where you can hide behind “good effort.” The models either tie out or they do not.

People who do well here tend to:

  • Take pride in accuracy and consistency, even on the unglamorous stuff
  • Catch issues early and fix them without needing a lot of airtime
  • Ask sharp questions and then go do the work to answer them
  • Communicate clearly in English, both in writing and live, because you will work with U.S.-based executives and investors
  • Stay calm when priorities shift, and still deliver something clean

Requirements

  • Solid accounting and finance fundamentals (you do not need to be a CPA, but you do need to know what you are looking at)

The Advisory Solutions team at Nutanix is a global team that provides innovative solutions and strategic guidance to clients. Responder pela conferência e registro de notas fiscais em sistema integrado, bem como o fluxo de informações referente ao processo de farmácia;

  • Abastecer as prateleiras com os medicamentos dos residentes, para permitir o rápido e permanente atendimento;
  • Proceder à recepção e conferência de medicamentos e análogos, comparando a quantidade e especificação expressa na nota de entrega com os produtos recebidos, bem como, embalar e rotular as embalagens;
  • Auxiliar o farmacêutico na manipulação, separação e distribuição de produtos químicos e outros preparados;
  • Atender os usuários da farmácia, verificando a autorização da medicação e fornecendo os produtos, registrando a saída dos mesmos;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e manutenção das prateleiras, balcões e aparelhos existentes na farmácia e outras áreas de trabalho, mantendo em boas condições de aparência e uso;
  • Etiquetar os medicamentos, produtos e materiais farmacêuticos de acordo com orientação de seu superior assegurando a identificação dos itens;
  • Realizar o controle de temperatura ambiente e refrigeradores de acordo com a necessidade de cada medicamento;
  • Efetuar atendimento verificando receitas, embrulhando e entregando os produtos, de acordo com as receitas/prescrições médicas;
  • Proceder à recepção e conferência de medicamentos e análogos, comparando a quantidade e especificação expressa na nota de entrega com os produtos recebidos;
  • Montar os kits de medicamentos, aspiração, equipes e curativos, de acordo com a necessidade de cada paciente;
  • Liberar dietas e suplementos conforme solicitação, bem como os materiais de limpeza de acordo com o uso;
  • Receber e conferir entregas dos materiais da farmácia, limpeza e nutrição e de medicamentos;
  • Realizar a cobrança no sistema de todas as liberações.

Main Responsibilities · Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators. · Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings. · Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets. · Track the performance and movements of financial assets. · Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts. · Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis. · Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials. · Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications. Requirements · Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory). · Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields. · Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments. · Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports. · Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail. · Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling). · Clear and structured written communication skills. · Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events. Differentials · Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets. · Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters. · Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.G., Python, VBA, Power BI). Benefits · Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market. · Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm. · Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development. · Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Data Architect
description: About You You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization. Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora. Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development. Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance. Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance. Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation. Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance. Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora. Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies. Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions. Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads. Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers. Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments. Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective. Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies. Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams. Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses. Additional Information About Us At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Coordenador De Contabilidade
description:
Buscamos um profissional para atuar como COORDENADOR CONTÁBIL em um provedor de serviços logísticos no Brasil e no Exterior. Será responsável por liderar e organizar as atividades das áreas Contábil e Fiscal, garantindo o cumprimento de metas, prazos e conformidade com normas e legislações. Atuar na orientação técnica a clientes internos, coordenar auditorias externas e fiscalizações, conduzir o fechamento contábil e assegurar o compliance fiscal das empresas do grupo. REQUISITOS Formação Superior Completa em Ciências Contábeis com CRC ativo. Desejável Pós Graduação em Controladoria / Finanças / Gestão Tributária. Inglês intermediário, desejável avançado. 5 anos de experiência profissional em empresas multinacionais e/ou nacionais. Conhecimento de apuração de todos os tributos e entrega de obrigações acessórias munipais, estaduais e federais. Experiência em planejamento tributário. Experiência em revisão e elaboração de conciliação, análise de contas patrimoniais e resultado. Experiência no preparo de demonstrações financeiras e caderno de auditoria, demonstrações financeiras base para publicação. Conhecimento e aplicação das normas contábeis vigentes e revisão de demonstrações financeiras para a companhia de valores imobiliários. Conhecimento e aplicação normas contábeis e IFRS. Desejável conhecimento operacional módulo contábil: FI/CO - ERP SAP. Desejável conhecimento em sistema fiscal (cockpit SAP). Excel avançado. Foco no cliente internos e apoio à boa gestão da empresa. RESPONSABILIDADES: Atender amplamente a auditoria externa, analisando as solicitações, esclarecendo contabilizações, controlando cronogramas e demandas, garantindo que as demonstrações reproduzam fielmente a situação fiscal, contábil e financeira. Desenvolver equipes fiscal e contábil promovendo a sinergia das áreas, visando a ampliação do conhecimento dos colaboradores. Aprovar conciliações de todas as contas contábeis mantendo as principais em dia evitando divergências com auditoria externa ou não cumprimento das normas contábeis e fiscais vigentes. Distribuir e implementar plano de ação carta de controles internos de auditoria externa, para redução ou mitigação dos pontos no próximo período. Revisar e garantir a entrega de todas as obrigações junto aos orgãos Ferderais, Estaduais e municipais. Aprovar e acompanhar as rotinas de encerramento de exercício e melhorias em sistemas, avançando em melhores práticas de controles fiscais e contábeis. Prestar orientação contábil e fiscal para os clientes internos relativo ao caderno de auditoria, operações, legislação vigente ou demais situações técnicas para a correta aplicação e não exposição da empresa. Transmitir as informações a usuários e órgãos reguladores,. Aprovar lançamentos provenientes de reorganização societária para atendimento a normas vigentes. Elaborar comentário sobre desempenho e relatório da diretoria nas demonstrações Financeiras auditadas;
Assegurar a entrega no prazo e correta de todas as obrigações acessórias nas diversas esferas tributárias, garantindo o compliance fiscal. Assegurar que as operações fiscais da organização estejam ocorrendo em conformidade com a legislação fiscal corrente evitando autuações, multas e sanções. Analisar e buscar o aproveitamento dos créditos tributários obtidos pela empresa, por meio de compensações, restituições ou transferência para outras unidades, contribuindo para a melhora no caixa e resultado. Orientar e transmitir à equipe fiscal as mudanças ocorridas na legislação fiscal, por meio de instruções e informativos, garantindo que todos os colaboradores estejam atualizados. Decidir com segurança e clareza sobre questões dúbias ou polêmicas referente a tributação, por meio de análise criteriosa da legislação vigente, buscando evitar os riscos de passivo. Contribuir no adequado fechamento contábil, validando saldos contábeis a pagar e a recuperar de tributos. Identificar oportunidades de redução na carga fiscal, discutindo interna e externamente sobre possibilidades decorrentes do nosso negócio ou posicionamento dos fiscos e tribunais. Assegurar que todos os registros fiscais sejam efetuados dentro do período de competência, através da de controles das atividades e dos relatórios de apuração extraídos do sistema. Coordenar o atendimento aos processos de fiscalização, auditorias internas e externa ocorridos na empresa. REMUNERAÇÃO: Pacote atraente, com Bônus diferenciado e Benefícios completos! LOCAL DE TRABALHO: Rio de Janeiro, RJ

title: Sales & Trading Intern
description: Sobre o Grupo BCP Securities Fundada em 1989, a BCP Securities, Inc. é uma corretora e banco de investimento americano com foco em renda fixa em mercados emergentes. Nossa atuação inclui uma mesa ativa de negociações no mercado secundário, promovendo liquidez e transparência para os clientes. Expandindo do mercado offshore para o mercado local, a BCP DTVM combina expertise técnica e agilidade, atendendo empresas, investidores institucionais e family offices com soluções sólidas e inovadoras. Local de Trabalho : cidade do Rio de Janeiro, 100% presencial Tipo de Contrato : estágio Principais Responsabilidades: Apoiar a mesa de Sales & Trading no acompanhamento diário do mercado local de renda fixa, com foco em crédito privado (debêntures, CRIs, CRAs, notas comerciais e outros instrumentos). Auxiliar na atualização e controle das posições da mesa, acompanhando marcação a mercado, preços, spreads e movimentações diárias. Apoiar a equipe de Sales no atendimento a demandas de clientes institucionais, family offices e investidores profissionais, incluindo envio de cotações, informações de mercado e materiais de suporte. Monitorar e organizar o pipeline de oportunidades no mercado secundário, contribuindo com a execução e acompanhamento de negociações. Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e “market updates” (diários e semanais), incluindo destaques do mercado, principais movimentos e níveis indicativos. Utilizar sistemas internos e plataformas de mercado (ex.: Bloomberg, ANBIMA, B3, CETIP/NoMe/RTC, conforme aplicável) para consultas de preços, volumes e informações dos ativos. Auxiliar na checagem de operações e interface com áreas de Middle/Backoffice, garantindo alinhamento entre negociação, registro e liquidação. Organizar bases de dados, planilhas e controles internos, garantindo consistência e qualidade das informações. Apoiar projetos de melhoria de processos e automação de rotinas (Excel/VBA/Python, quando aplicável). Colaborar com o time na preparação de apresentações, materiais comerciais e documentos de apoio para reuniões com clientes. Requisitos: Cursando graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas. Interesse genuíno por mercado financeiro, especialmente renda fixa, crédito privado e macroeconomia local. Excel intermediário/avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, organização de bases). Boa capacidade analítica, atenção a detalhes e perfil organizado. Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com postura profissional para interação com áreas internas e clientes. Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão, com agilidade e priorização em rotina de mesa. Disponibilidade para estágio presencial na cidade do Rio de Janeiro (Ipanema). Diferenciais: Conhecimento básico de produtos de renda fixa (duration, curva, spread, marcação a mercado). Familiaridade com Bloomberg e/ou plataformas de negociação. Noções de VBA, Python, Power BI ou automação de relatórios. Inglês intermediário/avançado. Benefícios: Bolsa Estágio Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa global com forte atuação no mercado de renda fixa. Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e dinâmico.

Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding‑edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high‑performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution.
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments.
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms.
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community.
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel.
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel.
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners.

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded.
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers.
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals.
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git.
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded.
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging.
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other low‑level system engineering.
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives.
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Please note that this role is based in Saudi Arabia on a permanent, residential basis.

Overview

We are seeking an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer to join Petroleum Engineering/Oil Reservoir Management Department.

Petroleum Engineering/Oil Reservoir Management Department is responsible for developing and managing world-class fields, reservoirs, and reserves, leveraging cutting‑edge technology and innovation at our state‑of‑the‑art Exploration and Petroleum Engineering Center in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia. Our organization also conducts pioneering research, introduces new technologies, and provides engineering services as part of our customized reservoir management practices.

As an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer your primary role is to serve as an expert in Oil Reservoir Management, providing guidance and expert advice to the design, implementation, and optimization of best‑in‑class reservoir management programs for the world’s largest onshore and offshore oil fields. The position is embedded within Petroleum Engineering business and as a senior technical role, you will engage with leaders and experts from across the upstream business.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide expert guidance and oversight on best‑in‑class reservoir management principles, practices, and cutting‑edge technologies across all Saudi Aramco hydrocarbon assets.
  • Formulate reservoir development, data acquisition, strategic surveillance, and monitoring of masterplans to optimize asset development and depletion strategies. This involves utilizing established reservoir management standards and guidelines to
  • Maximize Net Present Value (NPV) and hydrocarbon recovery.
  • Lead, design and practice in integrated field reviews and field development plans.
  • Prepare critical reservoir engineering inputs for drilling and workover proposals and programs, recommending innovative completion techniques for complex well configurations, including: horizontal and multilateral wells.
  • Lead and participate in reservoir engineering studies focused on optimizing ultimate recovery through reservoir stimulation modeling of various Improved Oil Recovery (IOR) processes.
  • Engage in professional development activities, such as: participating in technical societies and groups, sharing expertise, and mentoring young engineers to foster growth and excellence within the organization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum Engineering or a related Engineering discipline from an accredited university. Advanced degree is a plus.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience including at least 7 years specializing in oil reservoir management.
  • Training history of appropriate specialized courses and seminars is expected.
  • Knowledge of open‑hole and cased‑hole logs, geological modeling, simulation, completion and production procedures and technologies.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise are required in formation evaluation, geological modeling, simulation, reservoir appraisal and field development planning, completion, production/injection procedures-strategy‑technologies, water flooding, reservoir surveillance, SCAL, PVT, geochemical analysis, and fluid's compatibility.
  • Expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data analytics are preferred.
  • History of using modern reservoir management practices for oil reservoirs.
Working environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector‑specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a unique position in the global energy industry. We are the world’s largest producer of hydrocarbons (oil and gas), with the lowest upstream carbon intensity of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generational spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como os serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Descrição da vaga

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

description:
Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu. Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Landscape helps manage policy, compliance, patch management, and access control across large estates.

We have a system that serves thousands of deployments, and we want to give it a fresh vision. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.

Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills. You will work closely with product managers and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. You will grow a team of engineers, collaborate with other engineering and business teams, and provide periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.

As an engineering manager you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage, helping them grow as engineers.

Key Responsibilities
  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your region
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands‑on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organization

  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open‑source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel 4–6 weeks per year for internal and external events
Valued Skills and Experience
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development

  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. title: Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil
description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi CaseCEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.

While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.

The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

This role reports to the CISO.

What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change

What we are looking for

  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness

Optional things we value

  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

title: Técnico de Engenharia Clínica
description:
Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica

O Técnico de Engenharia Clínica é o profissional técnico responsável por assegurar o funcionamento contínuo, seguro e eficaz do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele executa manutenções preventivas, corretivas, calibrações e ensaios, garantindo a disponibilidade dos equipamentos para o atendimento ao paciente, em conformidade com as normas técnicas e os procedimentos internos. Sua atuação é fundamental para a segurança do paciente e a eficiência operacional da instituição de saúde.

  • Execução de Manutenções e Intervenções Técnicas: Realizar manutenções corretivas nos equipamentos médico-hospitalares, desde a abertura do chamado até a identificação da falha e a intervenção técnica, visando restaurar todas as funcionalidades e retomar a operação de forma segura. Executar manutenções planejadas/programadas (preventivas e preditivas), utilizando padrões e simuladores adequados, para garantir que os equipamentos estejam sempre aptos para uso seguro, com laudos e certificados válidos. Realizar calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica nos equipamentos, seguindo os procedimentos e normas técnicas aplicáveis, para assegurar a precisão e a segurança dos dispositivos.
  • Gestão de Equipamentos e Controle Patrimonial: Realizar o controle e rastreio de equipamentos por meio de rondas diárias, verificando o estado geral, a localização e a condição de uso, para garantir sua conservação e disponibilidade. Acompanhar o recebimento de novos equipamentos e insumos, conferindo notas fiscais e a contagem dos produtos, e testando os equipamentos para verificar sua aptidão para o uso. Preservar e zelar pelos equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, mantendo-os organizados, limpos e conservados, e solicitando novas ferramentas ao supervisor quando necessário, demonstrando cuidado com o patrimônio da empresa.
  • Documentação e Registro no Sistema: Alimentar o sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), realizando a abertura de Ordens de Serviço (OS) e preenchendo detalhadamente as ações executadas, peças utilizadas e observações, para garantir um histórico preciso e completo do equipamento. Assegurar a correta emissão de laudos e certificados de acordo com as normativas vigentes, após a execução das manutenções e calibrações.
  • Acompanhamento e Suporte: Manter o supervisor imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e os desafios encontrados, buscando soluções e alinhando as atividades diariamente. Acompanhar as atividades de serviços realizados por terceiros dentro da unidade, por meio da análise de ordens de serviço externas, para garantir o registro e histórico completo dos equipamentos. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo que venham a ser delegadas pelo supervisor de engenharia clínica.
  • Relacionamento e Otimização: Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações conforme a necessidade do cliente, através do contato com fornecedores, com o objetivo de apoiar a ampliação dos serviços e soluções oferecidas.

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.

Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.

Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.

“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.

Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.

Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.

“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

title: Research Fellow-3
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.
Core Competencies
  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.
Minimum Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$45,000-$55,000

  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de influenciar diferentes stakeholders.
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado para resultados.
  • Diferenciais: conhecimento em Power BI, SQL, experiência em IA.

Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.

Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. About TestBox

TestBox was founded with a bold mission : to fundamentally transform how software is bought and sold. We're building an innovative platform that empowers buyers with transparent, interactive software experiences, while equipping sellers with powerful tools to deliver exceptional buying and onboarding journeys. Our core technologies—synthetic data, intelligent orchestration, and our unique product graph—help teams achieve faster implementations, clearer insights, and increase trust with their customers.

At TestBox, we're not just improving demos; we're building the next generation infrastructure for software transactions, creating seamless experiences from initial interest to successful onboarding and beyond.

We're a fast-growing startup built by a team that values experimentation, velocity, and customer impact. We're backed by world-class investors and are building a platform that's disrupting the traditional B2B sales motion.

Role Overview

As a Solutions Architect at TestBox, you'll be at the heart of our customer experience—designing, building, and delivering high-impact demo and POC environments that drive sales success for our customers.

You’ll lead technical delivery, participate in agile rituals like standups and retros, and act as a trusted consultant to help customers design stories that resonate. You’ll also be expected to innovate and move fast—this isn't a role for someone looking to just “follow the playbook.”

To succeed here, you’ll need to be curious, flexible, and scrappy. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams, and you’ll use AI tools (including our own) daily to boost your productivity, generate data, and solve complex problems creatively.

Key Responsibilities Project Ownership & Delivery
  • Lead end-to-end implementation of customer demo and POC environments—from kickoff through delivery.
  • Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and retros; communicate blockers and drive timelines forward.
  • Collaborate across customer engineering, solutions, and product teams to ensure smooth handoffs and clear technical execution.
Customer Storytelling & Consulting
  • Help customers craft compelling demo narratives grounded in real-world buyer personas, workflows, and industry context.
  • Design fictional yet realistic companies and user journeys to simulate how the product solves specific problems.
  • Advise on best practices for demo structure, content pacing, and emotional resonance.
Environment Implementation
  • Configure CRM, support, or comms tools with customized fields, workflows, and industry templates.
  • Simulate real user behavior using automation, time-based triggers, and behavioral scripting. (We integrate AI-powered interactions where relevant to enhance realism)
AI-Driven Efficiency
  • Leverage AI tools (including LLMs like OpenAI and Anthropic, automation platforms) to speed up data generation, ticket writing, and documentation.
  • Continuously explore ways to innovate and disrupt traditional workflows using AI—TestBox is built on this mindset.
Documentation & Ticket Writing
  • Create detailed technical tickets and documentation to support repeatable environment setup and engineering handoffs.
  • Maintain internal knowledge resources for templates, industry scenarios, and technical edge cases.
Who You Are
  • You're fluent in english.
  • You're resourceful, autonomous, and outcomes-driven —comfortable leading projects with limited structure.
  • You think like a builder, act like an owner, and communicate like a product manager.
  • You thrive in startups : ambiguity excites you, pivots don't scare you, and you prioritize speed over perfection.
  • You believe AI is a power tool , not a novelty—and you're already using it to make your work better and faster.
  • You're comfortable translating between customer needs and technical systems, and enjoy being at the intersection of product, engineering, and sales.
Preferred Qualifications
  • 3–5 years in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, Implementation, or similar technical consulting roles.
  • Ability to write and manage technical tickets and documentation for delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, and data formats like CSV and JSON.
  • Experience working in agile environments (standups, retros, ticket grooming, etc.).
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, text‑to‑speech engines, automation platforms) to drive efficiency, draft technical documentation, create demo content, or solve complex problems.
  • Bonus : Familiarity with synthetic data or interactive storytelling in demos. Completion of AI‑focused courses, certifications, or hands‑on projects.
Why Join TestBox
  • Shape the future of how software is bought and sold.
  • Build with a team that values autonomy, curiosity, and experimentation.
  • Use AI every day—not as a gimmick, but as a core productivity engine.
  • Make a direct impact in a high-growth startup redefining the demo experience.

1.2 – Participa, junto ao Serviço de Orientação Religiosa, do planejamento dos dias de formação e convivência.

1.3 – Colabora com informações relevantes no processo de avaliação de professores, em parceria com as CPS’s , a partir do acompanhamento realizado aos estudantes.
